senses.gloss:
Kuṭhāramukha : m.: A mythical serpent.

Born in the kula of Dhṛtarāṣṭra, offered in the snake sacrifice of Janamejaya; ‘fast as wind’ (vātavega) and ‘very poisonous’ (viṣolbaṇa) 1. 52. 14, 13, 1.
